messages:
maria: Heads-up — us-west-2 GPU pool under steady batch pressure since 09:10. 99p latency for text-gen ~380ms (SLO 200ms). max_batch=64, queue depth rising.
ops-oncall: Oncall here, checking. Any recent deploys or rollout hooks?
maria: No deploys from our side. Traffic spike looks like demo/ingest teams. Prefill/KV-heavy requests are amplifying batching.
sanjay: Confirming from infra dashboards: GPU util 92%, admission drop rate ~14%, per-shard queue length median 18 reqs. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/io/runs/abc123
olivia: If this is queueing, temporarily ratcheting max_batch down to 32 should reduce wait time (tradeoff: higher per-token cost). Any objections?
kai: I can update admission controller for the us-west-2 pool. Suggest also lowering batch_window_ms to 8ms to reduce headroom. Will that impact small-payload latency?
maria: Model X/Y validated at max_batch=32 in perf tests — safe. Do a staged rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> full, watch 99p and error rates.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout config/admission/us-west-2 -> {max_batch:32, batch_window_ms:8, canary:10%} by kai
olivia: Canary results coming in: canary hosts 99p down to ~210ms, overall still ~330ms. If canary stable for 5m, ramp to 50%.
sanjay: Also recommend rerouting low-priority lanes to eu-central while we stabilize — avoid blowing tail across fleet. Cost implications noted.
kai: Kicked off rebalancer job: moving ~12% low-priority sessions to eu-central (TTL migration). ETA ~2m.
maria: After first changes, queue depth on canary shards dropping ~60%. Continue to monitor for 15m then decide on capacity bump vs permanent config.
ops-oncall: Action items: (1) kai - finish rebalancer (2) olivia - watch SLOs & error spike (3) sanjay - estimate cost delta for reroute. Created PD incident: https://pd.redwood/INC-4921
olivia: Adding dashboard panels for batch_window_ms, admission_drop_rate, per-shard queue length; also a quick alert if 99p > 250ms for >2m.
maria: If this becomes a nightly pattern we should provision reserved capacity for peak window. Filing infra ticket now.
sanjay: Filed TICKET-1284: reserved-capacity-us-west2-peak.
maria: Thanks everyone — will close after 30m stable. Updating thread as we see numbers. :white_check_mark:
